summary: This video showcases an Aura element team competing in Crisis Rally Area Boss 2 against the Level 300 Tainted Guard. Using a lineup of Talethia, Anneliesis, Diantha, Lincos, and Child of Chaos, the setup achieves over 7.64 billion total damage. Talethia serves as the hyper-carry, dealing over 7 billion damage on her own. Complete hero stats, gear builds, and precise skill timing presets are shown at the end of the video.
